name: Tim Plunkett
headline: Head of Direct Sales Oracle NetSuite - ANZ
about:
With nearly 30 years of experience in business process analysis, accounting, and enterprise software, I’m passionate about helping organisations streamline operations and achieve sustainable growth. As part of the regional leadership team at NetSuite, I’ve contributed to the company’s expansion and reputation as a trusted ERP partner for businesses across finance, wholesale and distribution, manufacturing, and project management.

My focus is on leading sales teams, managing complex solution sales, and building strong client relationships in dynamic and competitive markets. I enjoy collaborating with stakeholders at all levels—from internal teams to C-suite executives—to understand business needs and deliver tailored, value-driven solutions.

Throughout my career, I’ve been involved in new business development, key account management, and ongoing client success. I’m committed to continuous improvement, both in sales processes and in the way we deliver solutions to customers.

Core strengths:
• Sales leadership & team management
• Regional business development & growth
• Complex solution selling (ERP/Cloud)
• Account management & client retention
• Strategic partnerships
• Business process improvement
• Stakeholder engagement

Happy to chat about ERP, digital transformation, or how technology can drive business growth.

experiences.position: NetSuite Account Executive - Manufacturing & Wholesale Distribution
experiences.description:
#1 Cloud Business Software

With more than 40,000 organizations, NetSuite is 10 times larger than the nearest competitor, meaning 10 times the resources. Comprehensive functionality with industry-specific support for a broad range of industries means NetSuite works the way your business works. Built from the ground up for the cloud, NetSuite lowers costs and reduces hassle for IT. One data model spanning back office financials to customer records to professional services provides complete visibility and simplified integration.
